title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go, parity fixes, bump v1.95.0
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: multiple SDKs (python/typescript/go) diverged in auth token refresh semantics, retry backoff defaults, and streaming ergonomics which is causing customer confusion and inconsistent server load patterns. This PR unifies auth and retry behavior, improves streaming ergonomics (context managers/async iterators/abort signals), fixes API parity gaps, and bumps SDK versions to v1.95.0. Changes include: consolidated RetryPolicy abstraction (max_attempts, backoff_base, jitter, retryable_statuses) exported in each SDK; consistent auth refresh hooks that automatically refresh short-lived tokens and expose a simple on_token_refresh callback for integrations; streaming API ergonomics: Python adds StreamClient as an async context manager and a generator-based async iterator for responses, TypeScript streaming now exposes an EventEmitter + async iterable with AbortSignal support, Go exposes ReadStream with Close and Context cancellation support; parity fixes: method names (create_chat -> Chat.create) and parameter names aligned across SDKs, renamed `max_retries` -> `retry_policy.max_attempts` everywhere; docs/changelogs and examples updated with migration notes. Tests: unit tests added for retry jitter distribution and streaming cancellation, e2e test added to verify auth refresh under long-lived streams. Migration notes: developers should replace existing retry args with the new RetryPolicy object and switch to the new streaming patterns (examples provided).
commits: feat(py): add RetryPolicy and unify token refresh hook
feat(ts): streaming iterator + abort signal integration
feat(go): export RetryPolicy and StreamReader with Context cancellation
fix(py): align method names for parity with TS/Go
chore: bump sdk versions to v1.95.0 and update changelogs
test: add retry/backoff unit tests and streaming cancellation e2e
review_comments: Diego: Could we make the default backoff_base a configuration value surfaced in the top-level client? I think ops teams will want to tune without touching RetryPolicy internals. Author: Added client-level option `retry_defaults` and documented in upgrade guide.
Priya: The TS linter failure was due to the new async iterator polyfill. Can we re-run lint after the polyfill change? Author: Lint fixed and CI re-run green.
Luca: For Go, ensure StreamReader.Close() is idempotent and safe to call from deferred functions. Author: Close is now idempotent and unit tests added.
Ops: e2e showed a token refresh race under heavy load, suggest adding an atomic refresh guard. Author: Added singleflight-style guard to auth refresh path and included a benchmark.
release_notes: - SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go) v1.95.0: Unified RetryPolicy and auth refresh semantics. - Streaming ergonomics improved: context managers/async iterators/AbortSignal/Context cancellation. - Parity fixes: aligned method/parameter names across SDKs. - Migration notes added to docs and examples.
